messages:
mira: Quick design pass on dark-mode console UI. Spotted a few accessibility + UX nits. PR: https://git.redwood.example/infra/console-theme/pulls/73

mira: Major items: code block contrast, chart legend opacity, tiny icon focus, and a heatmap colormap that conflicts with syntax colors.
sam: On my end the code block background is fine but the token colors read too similar to UI labels at 13px. Need clearer hue separation.

ivy: For charts: legend labels at 50% alpha vanish on low-brightness monitors. Suggest default legend alpha 0.9, hover to 1.0.

jules: Copy nit: action menu button `Run` is ambiguous in compact table. Recommend `Trigger` (short) or `Run job` (explicit). Leaning `Trigger`.

mira: OK `Trigger` then. Sam, can you propose token hexes that avoid clashes with the heatmap?

sam: Proposing tokens: keyword #bfe9ff, fn-name #9be8c9, string #ffdbaa, comment #7b8594. All test >=4.5:1 against #070809.

theme-bot: accessibility-scan: comment color #7b8594 on #070809 = 4.4:1 (marginal). Recommend bump to #6c7684 for better pass.

iv y: For heatmap switch from rainbow to purple->amber stops: #22002b, #5a2f89, #b05fae, #ffd27a. Monotonic lightness helps mid-range reads.

sam: I'll adjust comment to #6c7684 and update storybook tokens + heatmap story.

mira: Also update focus for icon buttons: 2px solid #9ad3ff with 6px offset for keyboard-only. Jules, you'll update copy keys?

jules: Yep, changing i18n key `action.run.label` -> `action.trigger.label`. Will add fallback.

mira: Great. Please :+1: or :eyes: once you've reviewed the PR. I'll merge after screenshots.

jules: :+1:

sam: :eyes: uploading stories now.

mira: Thanks — will include rollback flag in release notes in case metrics spike post-rollout.
